header: The founding story beside a portrait
lead: Rich text in one column, a portrait with a caption beside it, and the founder's name and role at the end.
bodytext:
Lines stop at 65 characters, even in the wide version. The width field sets how much room the picture gets, not the line length, because long lines are hard to read.

The name comes at the end of the story, not the start. Readers learn what happened first, and then who did it.

The reverse switch moves the portrait to the other side without changing the source order, so the story is always read first.
caption: The caption belongs to the picture, not to the story.
author: The founder's name
